messages:
tara: Heads-up, ingest sequencing test found sampling+late-enrich causing billing to show 'unknown-tenant' for some traces. Need quick tradeoffs.

matt: Any repro?

tara: Short repro: 3-span trace where B gets tenant via async KV after sampling. If B is dropped and later rehydrated, billing loses tenant.

alex: Two options: pre-enrich at edge or keep a tiny envelope for dropped spans to stitch later. Both have tradeoffs.

samir: Paste the example?

tara: ```json
{
  "trace_id":"t1",
  "spans":[{"id":"A","attrs":{"tenant":"acct_42"}},{"id":"B","attrs":{}},{"id":"C","attrs":{}}]
}
```
B gets tenant later; sampling decides before that.

matt: Brainstorm: pre-enrich (higher p99), client-side tenant token, store minimal metadata for dropped spans (envelope), or trace-level sampling.

alex: Minimal envelope seems pragmatic: keep {trace_id, tenant, ts} for short TTL (e.g., 5m). Cost: ~200B/entry worst-case -> multi-GB at high peak, ok for Dedicated, heavy for Hosted.

samir: Could gate by customer tier.

tara: Also need audit: if TTL expired we must show unknown and log.

ingest-bot: deploy-job: staging-prefix-cache-extend queued by matt at 2026-03-22T15:10Z

samir: Hybrid idea: only hold placeholders when tenant missing (defer-sample) for short window (10s) to allow enrichment to land. Less overall retention.

alex: Nice — reduces global cost but adds gateway state.

matt: Proposal: short-term: placeholder flow (TTL 10s, ~64B metadata). Mid: enterprise prefix-cache retention. Long: push tenant token into SDK. Add metrics: placeholders gauge, tenant-rehydrate counter, stitched vs unknown. SLI: <=0.1% unknown for enterprise.

tara: Action items: matt -> prototype placeholder in gateway (PR by EOW). alex -> capacity calc for enterprise prefix-cache. samir -> update dashboards for placeholders + rehydrate counter. I'll file RFC if prototype OK. :thumbsup:

alex: Document billing semantics: stitched attribution only valid within TTL; after TTL billing is unknown unless customer requests backfill.

matt: will include experiment_id in placeholder.

tara: thanks all, will close and post PR link when ready. :raised_hands:
